properties.entry: INSERT INTO attendance_tbl (member_id, attend_date, check_in, check_out, status, memo) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

SELECT a.status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance_tbl a JOIN class_day_tbl c ON c.class_date = a.attend_date WHERE a.member_id = ? AND a.attend_date BETWEEN ? AND ? AND c.is_class_day = TRUE GROUP BY a.status
SELECT member_id, name, ym, record_cnt, present_cnt, late_cnt, early_cnt, outing_cnt, absent_cnt, excused_cnt FROM v_monthly_attendance WHERE ym = ? ORDER BY member_id

SELECT member_id, name, ym, SUM(record_cnt) AS record_cnt, SUM(present_cnt) AS present_cnt, SUM(late_cnt) AS late_cnt, SUM(early_cnt) AS early_cnt, SUM(outing_cnt) AS outing_cnt, SUM(absent_cnt) AS absent_cnt, SUM(excused_cnt) AS excused_cnt, (SUM(record_cnt) - SUM(excused_cnt) - (SUM(absent_cnt) + FLOOR((SUM(late_cnt) + SUM(early_cnt) + SUM(outing_cnt)) / ?))) * 100.0 / (SUM(record_cnt) - SUM(excused_cnt)) AS rate FROM v_monthly_attendance WHERE ym = ? GROUP BY member_id, name, ym HAVING rate < ? ORDER BY member_id
SELECT m.member_id, m.name, m.phone FROM member_tbl m LEFT JOIN attendance_tbl a ON a.member_id = m.member_id AND a.attend_date BETWEEN ? AND ? WHERE a.attendance_id IS NULL ORDER BY m.member_id
